theories.name: Libertarian theory
theories.role: Why the chain is shaped the way it is: participation is voluntary, preference is revealed by action rather than solicited, no central authority certifies the tally, and entry is open - anyone may run a node and verify.
expressedInDesign: Participation is an act, never a compulsion: nothing is recorded that a person did not choose to record.
Revealed preference over stated preference - the act itself is the datum.
No privileged verifier: every node re-executes every transaction and trusts no peer for state.
Open entry: the block format, the verifier and the replication endpoint are public.
Equal weight: one count per person, enforced by protocol rather than by promise.

theories.name: Macrobiotic Quantum Theory (MQT)
theories.role: The frame in which the ledger is read: a body of records is one macrobiotic quantum, its notes vertices of a 4D tesseract, and its links edges carrying state.

registers.theta_v: vacuum-duality angle, derived by atan2 over inward and outward links

magicAngle.meaning: the equilibrium reference at i = 0, between fusion (i = -1, inward) and fission (i = +1, outward)

expressedInDesign: Each block is a vertex; parentHash is the edge that carries state forward.
A commitment records that something existed without disclosing what it was - conscience without exposure.
Difficulty retargeting is an equilibrium-seeking control: it pulls the interval back toward its reference rather than toward an extreme.
